title: Concept: Node.js stack trace in a response
description: A stack trace with node_modules frames in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The trace names internal files, packages and versions, which is the inventory an attacker needs to pick a matching exploit for a dependency you already ship.
applicability: Deployments that render a stack trace with node_modules frames into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The trace names internal files, packages and versions, which is the inventory an attacker needs to pick a matching exploit for a dependency you already ship.
